title: Strange Printer
description:
A printer starts with a blank line of the length of lowercase string `s`. In one turn, it prints a single character over any nonempty contiguous interval, overwriting whatever was previously there.

Return the minimum number of turns needed to print exactly `s`.

## Examples

### Example 1

```text
Input: s = "aaabbb"
Output: 2
```

### Example 2

```text
Input: s = "aba"
Output: 2
```

## Constraints

- 1 <= s.length <= 100
- s consists of lowercase English letters.
